SGR 1806-20 is a §9magnetar§r, the most magnetic object known. White and black dwarf matter merge into it, and its field has to be untwisted for as long as it lives.

§5§lUNLOCK§r The T5 milestone:§9 6 batches§r at mean yield 0.9 or better with no fracture. Then:
- put the §9Magnetar Seed Core§r in escrow;
- build the §9galactic rim§r (stack 6: 7,154 Galactic Shell Plating) and bring compression to tier 6, with §9no star lit§r;
- buffer the merger charge:§9 18,432 L White Dwarf Matter + 4,608 L Black Dwarf Matter + 100,000 L Antipolarization Agent§r;
- put §9Star Chart: SGR 1806-20§r in the slot.

§5§lMAGNETAR §lMERGER§r The dynamo winds the polarity §9Π§r up by itself (+0.5 a second); no flares yet. Agent doses pull Π back toward 0.
1. §9Imprint:§r hold Π inside +60..+90 for 120 s in a row, within 600 s.
2. §9Release:§r bring Π back inside ±40 within 60 s.
A failure spends the charge and keeps the core.

§5§lRUN§r Each cycle:§9 3,000 L Antipolarization Agent§r (the constant feed) and 1.55 × 10¹⁴ EU (about 64 A MAX), for§9 15 L Magnetar Matter§r.
- The merger charge also fills a 60-cycle §9dwarf-matter reserve§r. At 10 cycles left the Eye tops it up from the buffers with§9 1,800 L White Dwarf + 450 L Black Dwarf Matter§r; an empty reserve starves the magnetar. Keep both stocked.
- The Eye gives back§9 12 Purified Tengam dust per 1,000 L§r of Agent burned, through the ME output bus.

§5§lTHE §lFIELD§r Four gauges: P, Θ, Ω and Π, and Π runs away by itself.
- The Agent feed charges the §9flare shield A§r (it settles near 40 with no trim). The shield soaks up to 25 Π a second.
- §9Giant flares§r come every 60-120 s, warned§9 15 s ahead with their sign§r, and push Π ±25 a second for 4 s.
- Pre-charge the shield on the warning: Agent in a Field socket, 100 L = A +4 (Θ +0.5), up to 5 a second.
- The other trims are the neutron star's: Spatially Enlarged Fluid, molten SpaceTime, Super Coolant and molten Purified Tengam.
Lose the magnetar and a re-merge needs the charge again, but not the core.

[note]Magnetar Matter is Eye T7's upkeep (7.5 L a cycle) and, later, a base of the T9 pellets. The road on is the §9Quasar Engine§r: T7 needs a linked quasar (the §cStability Link§r).[/note]

§2§lDONE §lWHEN§r you have held the core and the chart before the core goes into escrow (that task latches), and then 1,000 L of Magnetar Matter.
